```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

project_dir <- normalizePath("/home/xuyanbo/project/MOF_TAPS", mustWork = TRUE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3)

font_file <- "/home/xuyanbo/ARIAL.TTF"
font_family <- "sans"

if (file.exists(font_file)) {
  font_add(family = "Arial", regular = font_file)
  showtext_auto()
  showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
  font_family <- "Arial"
}

input_order <- c("1 ng", "100 pg", "10 pg")
method_order <- c("MOF-TAPS", "deMOF-TAPS")

method_colors <- c(
  "MOF-TAPS" = "#3B82C4",
  "deMOF-TAPS" = "#CB4335"
)

genome_chr <- paste0("chr", 1:22)

out_fig_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "analysis", "fig_factory", "fig", "FigSI", "PCR")
dir.create(out_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
theme_benchmark <- function(legend_position = "right") {
  theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = font_family) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.16, "cm"),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "black",
        lineheight = 1.3,
        margin = margin(t = 4)
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),

      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 8)),

      legend.position = legend_position,
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", margin = margin(l = 2)),
      legend.title = element_blank(),

      legend.key.width = unit(0.65, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.24, "cm"),
      legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.18, "cm"),

      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.background = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
}

plot_metric_bar <- function(df,
                            y_var,
                            y_label,
                            x_var = "input_amount",
                            show_x_text = TRUE,
                            show_legend = FALSE,
                            legend_position = "right",
                            bar_width = 0.55,
                            dodge_width = 0.72,
                            y_expand = c(0, 0.06),
                            y_limits = NULL,
                            y_breaks = waiver()) {

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_var]],
      y = .data[[y_var]],
      fill = method
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
      width = bar_width,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = method_colors,
      breaks = method_order,
      limits = method_order,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL,
      guide = guide_legend(
        ncol = 1,
        byrow = FALSE,
        keywidth = unit(0.65, "cm"),
        keyheight = unit(0.24, "cm"),
        override.aes = list(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25)
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = y_expand),
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = y_breaks
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_benchmark(if (show_legend) legend_position else "none")

  if (!show_x_text) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }

  p
}
```

# metadata
```{r}
samples <- c(
  "fym260124_S01", "fym260124_S02", "fym260124_S03",
  "fym260124_S04", "fym260124_S05", "fym260124_S06"
)

meta <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = samples,
  input_amount = case_when(
    sample %in% c("fym260124_S03", "fym260124_S06") ~ "1 ng",
    sample %in% c("fym260124_S02", "fym260124_S05") ~ "100 pg",
    sample %in% c("fym260124_S01", "fym260124_S04") ~ "10 pg",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  method = case_when(
    sample %in% c("fym260124_S01", "fym260124_S02", "fym260124_S03") ~ "deMOF-TAPS",
    sample %in% c("fym260124_S04", "fym260124_S05", "fym260124_S06") ~ "MOF-TAPS",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  results_dir = case_when(
    grepl("260124", sample) ~ file.path(project_dir, "analysis", "260124_1x", "result"),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    pcr_cycles = case_when(
      input_amount == "1 ng"   ~ "9",
      input_amount == "100 pg" ~ "13",
      input_amount == "10 pg"  ~ "17",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    x_label = paste0(input_amount, "\n", pcr_cycles),
    input_amount = factor(input_amount, levels = input_order),
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    x_label = factor(x_label, levels = c("1 ng\n9", "100 pg\n13", "10 pg\n17"))
  )

meta
```

```{r}
read_samtools_genome_coverage <- function(sample, results_dir, coverage_dir = "samtools_coverage") {
  f <- file.path(results_dir, "qc", coverage_dir, paste0(sample, ".coverage.txt"))

  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    stop("Missing samtools coverage file: ", f)
  }

  x <- data.table::fread(f)
  names(x) <- sub("^#", "", names(x))

  required_cols <- c("rname", "startpos", "endpos", "numreads", "covbases", "coverage", "meandepth")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(x))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in samtools coverage file: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      "\nFile: ", f
    )
  }

  x <- x %>%
    filter(rname %in% genome_chr) %>%
    mutate(
      startpos = as.numeric(startpos),
      endpos = as.numeric(endpos),
      covbases = as.numeric(covbases),
      region_len = endpos - startpos + 1
    )

  if (nrow(x) == 0) {
    stop("No autosomal genome chromosomes found in samtools coverage file: ", f)
  }

  genome_length <- sum(x$region_len, na.rm = TRUE)
  genome_covbases <- sum(x$covbases, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(
    sample = sample,
    pct_1x_100 = 100 * genome_covbases / genome_length
  )
}

cov_df <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(meta)), function(i) {
  read_samtools_genome_coverage(
    sample = meta$sample[i],
    results_dir = meta$results_dir[i],
    coverage_dir = "samtools_coverage"
  )
})) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")
```

```{r}
stats_df <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(meta)), function(i) {
  s <- meta$sample[i]
  f <- file.path(meta$results_dir[i], "05methy_dedup", paste0(s, ".dedup_mCtoT_all.stats"))

  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing stats file: ", f)

  x <- fread(f)
  cpg <- x[`#CONTEXT` == "CpG" & SPECIFIC_CONTEXT == "*"]

  data.table(
    sample = s,
    covered_cpg_m = cpg$COVERED_POSITIONS / 1e6
  )
})) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")
```

```{r}
dup_df <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(meta)), function(i) {
  s <- meta$sample[i]
  f <- file.path(meta$results_dir[i], "04dedup", paste0(s, ".metrics.txt"))

  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing duplication file: ", f)

  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  header_i <- which(startsWith(lines, "LIBRARY\t"))[1]
  if (is.na(header_i)) stop("Cannot find duplication header in: ", f)

  x <- fread(f, skip = header_i - 1, nrows = 1)

  data.table(
    sample = s,
    dup_100 = as.numeric(x[["PERCENT_DUPLICATION"]]) * 100
  )
})) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")
```

p_cov_single <- plot_metric_bar(
  df = cov_df,
  y_var = "pct_1x_100",
  y_label = "Genomic coverage (%)",

  y_breaks = seq(0, 25, 5)
)

  df = stats_df,
  y_var = "covered_cpg_m",
  y_label = "Covered CpGs (Millions)"
)

p_dup_single <- plot_metric_bar(
  df = dup_df,
  y_var = "dup_100",
  y_label = "Duplication rate (%)",
  y_limits = c(0, 30),
  y_breaks = seq(0, 30, 5),
  show_legend = TRUE
)
